Observed and literature-derived values are mixed with explicitly flagged proxies. Ningxia/Hetao annual water totals are divided uniformly by 12 because monthly district series were unavailable. Longyangxia storage is a Res-CN anomaly anchored to the physical operating range; Liujiaxia storage uses the HESS monthly regulation climatology. Reservoir loss contains satellite-derived evaporation only and is therefore a lower bound for L_res. Tangnaihai/Toudaoguai flows are observed for 2001-2014 and use 2001-2014 monthly climatology for 2015-2021. W3 is balance-derived; the inseparable Lanzhou-Toudaoguai residual is split equally across W4-W6. Ningxia crop-area gaps use linear interpolation and 2001-2004 backcasting from 2005; Hetao 2019-2020 uses linear interpolation to 2021. E3, E4 import capacity and L_base are scenario-scale proxies (1 GW renewable, 500 GWh/month import limit, 1000 GWh/month base load), not observations. Hetao pump head is a 5 m aggregate engineering proxy; 0.75 pump efficiencies are engineering assumptions. Executed reservoir releases, W2 inflow, intake-available flows, grid dispatch/allocation, executed pumping, reward components and policy actions remain blank because they are generated by the algorithm/environment.
